what: A CSS CRT overlay covers the whole page — 1px scanlines on a 3px period (shade .18), noise grain jittering in .4s steps(4) (.05), a reflection highlight at upper left (.05), edge darkness (.35), an inner bezel shadow, and a red −.8px · blue +.8px channel offset over the whole screen (SVG filter, off in Safari). Below 768px the offset and grain are turned off and the scanlines are lightened to a 4px period at .12.

options.chroma: Red/blue shift (px), default .8 — 0 turns it off (the filter is applied on the document root, so it is heavy)

from.where: All sections — CRT overlay (.crt-*) from shared.js and the #tds-chroma filter

note: Presses pass through to what is below (pointer-events: none). Shadow and reflected light are screen physics, so they are translucent black and white regardless of the skin. The amber CRT drawn with canvas is crt-glass
